newsitem.title: USA: Va. Power sees 781 MW Surry 2 on line today.
newsitem.headline: Va. Power sees 781 MW Surry 2 on line today.

text.p: Virginia Power Co said Monday its 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 2 nuclear power plant would return on line later today after being shut December 13 to replace a pipe section in its reactor coolant system.
"We should be on line today," said a company spokesman, adding it would take three days for Surry 2 to achieve full power production.
The nearby Surry 1, also rated at 781 MW, was running at 100 percent output.
The Gravel Neck, Va., generation units are wholly-owned by Dominion Resources, the parent of Virginia Power.
